units.source_text: 男踏歌会时，歌人在路上各站饮酒喝汤，这站叫作“水驿”。

en.t: At the men's kagai procession, the singers drank wine and sipped hot water at each stop along the road; these stops were called “water stations.”

units.source_text: 《竹河》是男踏歌会中唱的歌，故戏用此语。

en.t: “Takekawa” was a song sung at the men's kagai procession, so the phrase is used here playfully.
